description: This plot illustrates the MRR@10 performance of various Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) methods as a function of the number of queries used during inference. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference ($S$)." and features a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and uses a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The "DPR w/o query" method is represented by a solid black line with no markers, which remains constant horizontally at approximately 34.25 across the entire x-axis. The "DPR w/ gold" method is shown as a solid yellow line with circular markers; it enters the visible plot area at x=4 with a value of 33.0 and rises steadily to end at approximately 34.95 at x=10. The "DPR w/ top-1" method is depicted by a solid green line with circular markers, starting below the y-axis minimum at x=1, rising sharply to 34.7 at x=2, and continuing upward to reach 36.4 at x=10; an associated dashed green horizontal line is positioned at approximately 34.65. The "DPR w/ bottom-1" method, indicated by a solid purple line with circular markers, starts at 34.75 at x=1, peaks slightly at 35.05 at x=3, and gradually declines to 34.7 at x=10, accompanied by a dashed purple horizontal line at 34.9. The "DPR w/ random" method is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, beginning at 34.75 at x=1, rising to 35.25 at x=3, and remaining relatively steady to end at 35.3 at x=10, with a corresponding dashed blue horizontal line at 35.2. Finally, the "DPR w/ curriculum" method is shown as a solid red line with circular markers, starting at 35.15 at x=1, rising to 35.75 at x=6, and plateauing to end at 35.75 at x=10, with a dashed red horizontal line located at 35.6.
